copy.en: Glass-calm water mirrors autumn trees and misted ridges. A green-and-white coach sits by the cliff road; a few white cars further in. First snow along the peaks—travel traces small, the mountain large.
copy.zh: 湖面如镜，倒映秋色与雾中山脊。右岸陡壁旁停着一辆绿白巴士，中景有几辆白车。初雪贴着峰线，旅途的痕迹很小，山色很大。

alt.en: Red Maple on Still Water photograph
alt.zh: 红枫映水 摄影作品

copy.en: Among golden larches on the left, one deep red crown; a low brushy islet to the right. Mist and snow on the peaks; water nearly glass. One red note warms the whole cool frame.
copy.zh: 左岸金黄落叶松中夹一棵深红，右侧有矮岛灌丛。峰顶雾雪交叠，湖面几乎无纹。一点红，整幅冷调才有了温度。

alt.en: Red Heart on Snow Shore photograph
alt.zh: 雪岸红心 摄影作品

copy.en: Fresh snow and dry grass in front; still lake and golden conifers mid-frame. A large red heart sculpture on the left shore; colorful walkers scattered. Far peaks in mist—one red note waking the cold.
copy.zh: 前景新雪与枯草，中景静湖与金黄针叶林。岸左一枚大红心形装置，游人彩色衣点散落。远山入雾，一点红把冷场轻轻点醒。

alt.zh: 黄衣行者 摄影作品

copy.en: A thin dirt path crosses the green slope; lower left, a walker in a bright yellow jacket. Rocky peaks and snow behind dissolve into mist under a white sky. That one high note of color sets the mountain’s scale.
copy.zh: 绿坡上一条细土路，左下有穿亮黄外套的行人。后方岩峰与雪线被雾气遮住大半，天色白茫。一点高亮衣色，整幅山才有了尺度。

alt.zh: 雪峰下的湖与路 摄影作品

copy.en: Pale turquoise water fills the foreground, scrub dark along the near shore. A thin meadow sits before rocky peaks patched with snow and piled cumulus. Little wind; the quiet surface and mountain shade make the altitude feel sharp and still.
copy.zh: 湖面呈淡青，近岸灌丛压在暗影里。对岸草甸窄窄一条，再往后是带雪的岩峰与层积云。风不大，水色静，山体的阴影把高处的冷意写得很清楚。

alt.zh: 绿丘望雪峰 摄影作品

copy.en: A broad green hill fills the front, a faint path winding past a few small trees. Left rear, a snow peak brightens; white cloud hugs the mid-slope under clear blue. After grey weather, the mountain suddenly breathes light.
copy.zh: 前景大片绿丘，小路蜿蜒，几棵矮树点缀。左后方雪峰明亮，白云贴着山腰，头顶蓝天开朗。阴天之后的这一口气，山色一下子透亮。
竖构图里，下方是平顶建筑的小聚落，草坡起伏，阳光斑驳。上方岩峰覆厚雪，顶上压着暗云。人影极小，山的体量因此更沉。
copy.en: In a vertical frame, flat-roofed buildings sit in a green fold of hills under broken light. Above, rocky peaks hold heavy snow beneath dark cloud. A tiny figure makes the mountain mass feel absolute.

alt.zh: 雪山下的聚落 摄影作品

copy.zh: 一匹浅白马低头吃草，红缰绳拖在地上。背后是起伏绿丘与覆雪岩峰，厚云压顶。马很小，山很大，安静却不冷清。
copy.en: A pale horse grazes with its head down, a thin red lead trailing on the grass. Rolling green hills lead to snow-capped crags under heavy cloud. Small horse, large mountain—quiet without emptiness.

alt.zh: 白马吃草 摄影作品

title.en: Leading a Horse Across the Ridge

copy.zh: 草坡斜切画面，坡顶一人牵着红棕马缓行。黄花点在近处草间，大半幅是白亮的低云。人与马只占一线，旅途被缩成一个剪影。
copy.en: A grassy slope cuts diagonally; on the crest a figure leads a reddish-brown horse. Yellow flowers dot the near grass; bright low cloud fills most of the frame. Person and horse become a thin silhouette of the journey.

alt.zh: 牵马过脊 摄影作品
alt.en: Leading a Horse Across the Ridge photograph

copy.zh: 双车道柏油路呈 S 形爬升，黄线白线清晰，路面有横向减速标线。几辆车疏落地往前开，两侧是绿褐草坡与远山。竖幅把「还要走很久」说得很直白。
copy.en: A two-lane road climbs in an S-curve, yellow and white lines clean, rumble strips across the asphalt. A few cars spaced far apart; green-brown slopes and distant peaks on both sides. The vertical frame says plainly: a long way yet.

alt.zh: 盘山长路 摄影作品

copy.zh: 前景暗礁与青苔，一人立在蓝桨板上。对岸红瓦洋房、白圆建筑与摩天轮、玻璃高楼并排。海城交界，像把休闲写进天际线。
copy.en: Dark mossy rocks in front; one figure upright on a blue paddleboard. Across the water: red-tiled villas, a white round building, Ferris wheel, glass towers. Shore and city meeting—leisure written into the skyline.

alt.zh: 桨板与岸线 摄影作品

copy.zh: 俯看港池，红篷白壳小艇排成整齐行列。后方白灰游艇与岸上楼群。深蓝水面映着船体，秩序感干净。
copy.en: From above, red-canopy white boats dock in neat rows. Larger yachts and shore towers behind. Deep blue mirrors the hulls—order kept clean.

alt.zh: 红篷小艇 摄影作品

copy.zh: 前景海面飞起一群鸥，岸线绿树与红色螺旋雕塑醒目。玻璃高楼与红顶住宅挤在天际。蓝天干净，像把城市海风写成一张明信片。
copy.en: Gulls lift over teal water; green shore and the red May Wind coil clear. Glass towers and red-roof residences on the skyline. Clean blue—city sea breeze as a postcard.

alt.zh: 五月的风 摄影作品
alt.en: May Wind by the Shore photograph
